title: Network Data Scientist
content_text: Job # 527439 What You’ll Be Doing… The Wireless AI Innovation @ Verizon (WAIV) Team is seeking a unique technical lead for WAIV AI/ML projects, a creative lead who has learned the cutting-edge capabilities of AI/ML an envisions enhancements to engineering tools, and a strong influencer who is able to win over Verizon’s brightest SMEs through sound technical thought and diplomacy. Additionally, they must be process-minded to guide assigned projects to completion. Responsibilities Envision new network (engineering) AI/ML projects and present well-formed ideas to the team. Partner with team and non-team data scientists to teach complex network concepts, assess project feasibility, explain/select input features and validate project output. Envision and test for corner cases. Pull sample data sets from NS tools and V-Grid (formerly NDL), guiding team members on how to pull large amounts for prototyping. Compute ROI estimates in partnership with VLSS to determine the value and priority of a new idea that could become a project. Assess project priority by asking VLSS-style questions to understand and diagram workflows, and how new AI/ML projects could disrupt it. Publish blogs, create documentation, perform presentations, submit intellectual property write-ups and lead efforts for external publications. Engage SME groups such as the System Performance Core Team, the Assurance Core Team or Service Performance to explain, promote and request feedback on AI/ML project ideation and ongoing efforts. Learn the language, needs and terminology of data scientists to translate between them and business units for effective collaboration. What They’re Looking For… The WAIV team is a very fast-paced AI/ML team, acting as an internal start-up — prototyping software capabilities and installing them into the appropriate Verizon system as operational Beta Proof of Concept works. The role will primarily guide the WAIV team data scientists and team members in the entirety of the process of creating well-designed projects. As these projects are created, the technical lead role will also be skilled at writing publications, documentation and researching documentation on uncommon 5G/4G/Core topics. Publications are expected to be created in the form of internal blog posts, intellectual property, industry papers, conference presentations or collaborations with universities. You’ll Need To Have Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant work experience Even Better If You Have Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline. Six years of experience as a Network SME or three years as a Data Scientist with a history or process optimization projects. Wireless SME path: Ability to code in Python to create a prototype projects and speed up AI/ML development, engaging data scientists only when needed. Strong ability to understand, describe and comprehend ELPT/ALPT/5GPT KPIs, PCMD/ECDs-based datasets, and the far-reaching tools that use them. End-to-End Network experience– able to engage concepts of 5G, LTE, Core, Device, App-Layer, SIP, network slicing and network virtualization. Data Scientist path: Strong knowledge of Wireless Engineering processes and workflows would allow the role to envision new projects for our Wireless Engineering internal customer base immediately. Proficiency in use of scikit-learn, TensorFlow, Python, and model training on GPU. Ability to create, organize, present and write ideas. Excellent written and spoken communication skills are significant portion of the role. Expert-level Wireless Domain Expertise in RAN, Cell Builds, 5G, and End-to-End or advanced AI/ML model selection and training abilities. Ability to independently configure messaging to Director and above roles and lead presentations of appropriate length and content. Python scripting for data acquisition and Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). A passion for network process improvement through cutting edge ideas that many would dismiss as “too early” or “too much data.” Tableau (or similar) proficiency for demos and EDA. VLSS Green Belt or MBA for ROI calculations and workflow diagraming/comprehension. Experience filing IP, creating publications and research. History of requesting Network Systems toolset enhancements and features. History of project or vendor management. Willingness to travel. When you join Verizon… You’ll have the power to go beyond – doing the work that’s transforming how people, businesses and things connect with each other. Not only do they provide the fastest and most reliable network for their customers, but they were first to 5G – a quantum leap in connectivity. Their connected solutions are making communities stronger and enabling energy efficiency. Here, you’ll have the ability to make an impact and create positive change. Whether you think in code, words, pictures or numbers, join their team of the best and brightest. They offer great pay, amazing benefits and opportunity to learn and grow in every role. Together they’ll go far. Equal Employment Opportunity They’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer- and celebrate their employees’ differences, including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status. title: Data Scientist
content_text: They’re looking for talented, experienced Data Scientists to join their growing Data Science team. GoCardless is building a new global network for recurring payments. They’re cutting out the intermediaries and linking together direct debit schemes from around the world to create a simple way of collecting payments directly from customers’ bank accounts. Annual payment volume at GoCardless exceeds £10 billion, and they’re processing up to hundreds of thousands of transactions every day. As they grow, there is an increasing demand for data across all functions. Their ability to understand their users, and make sound and timely business decisions is hugely dependent their ability to extract meaning from this data. The data team exists to enable GoCardless to make smarter decisions by providing a combination of data oriented products, solutions and technologies. The data team is building data products that massively enhance the value and differentiation of their products at a global scale. THE ROLE Data is at the centre of their ability to add value to their customers and to their business. Fraud prevention, marketing optimisation, churn prevention, payment failure optimisation and upsell propensity are all areas of active work. You will work closely with cross-discipline teams, taking responsibility for end to end algorithm development from initial concept through to production readiness. They are looking for Data Scientists that will help them build predictive models that substantially increase the value that they provide to their customers and the efficiency of their operations by building new data products that leverage their growing volume of raw data. You will develop and productionise data products and predictive models in collaboration with your team. Working with Product Managers, software developers and subject matter experts, you’ll bring your own expertise to the team helping to move from abstract concepts, through design and build, to scalable algorithms that will deliver the teams goals. You will play a part in specifying the underlying infrastructure they are building to support the day to day work of Data Scientists and to enable models to be easily productionised. You will create meaningful data visualizations that communicate your findings and relate them back to how your insights create business impact. Who They’re Looking For You’re a self-starter – you can independently drive a team’s work forward, finding and exploiting opportunities where data science can impact our business objectives. You love digging into data and uncovering actionable insights You’re passionate about using data to help teams become more productive You have intellectual curiosity You are a communicative person that values building strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders and have the ability to explain complex topics in simple terms. Requirements You’ll have a degree (or PhD) in a numerate discipline (or have substantial relevant experience). You’ll have commercial experience building robust ML models in a production environment. You have strong technical skills in data manipulation and extraction (strong SQL knowledge), data analysis and model prototyping and productionisation (Python, R or similar) You have solid experience of deep-dive analysis of complex data; managing data quality; feature selection; and prototyping, validation, and productionisation of Machine Learning models. You’ll be able to point to a range of different techniques to solve a problem and demonstrate how you’re able to apply maths to data and deliver tangible, quantifiable business results. You have strong data visualisation skills You’re comfortable with writing and maintaining code. Their preference is that your language of choice for data-wrangling is Python. However, R is also an option during prototyping phases You have a track record of deploying predictive models and data products in production with quantifiable impact. Their team come from a variety of backgrounds and they welcome diversity – if you’re unsure, please apply. The post Data Scientist appeared first on Jobs Opendatascience .

title: Data Scientist
content_text: A BIT ABOUT THEIR DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS TEAM Kinship’s Data Science & Analytics team is core to their strategy. title: Data Scientist and Visualization Specialist
content_text: Summary They are seeking an enthusiastic teammate to join their small, inclusive, and dynamic team who will collaborates with a broad array of partners within Apple to distill data into actionable and intuitive visualizations that drive informed decisions. They work to understand challenging problems that arise during all stages of product design at Apple. The job requires fluency using statistics and visualizations to answer specific questions about datasets, proficient programming skills in R, Python, and/or MATLAB, and most importantly, a passion for creating informative visualizations and presentations to communicate results to all levels of the company. You are a person who approaches problem solving with curiosity and imagination, with a desire to learn new skills and a mindset that challenging questions are opportunities for insight. They are committed to professional development across all aspects of data visualization with mentorship and training opportunities both within and outside Apple. This includes, but is not limited to, providing team members opportunities to improve their skills in: graphic design, coding, visual arts, statistics, communication, and presentation. The DataViz team enables data-driven decision making by developing and performing analysis, modeling, and visualization of unstructured data for engineering and research design teams. Their unique position within the organization allows them to assist other teams on a wide range of products designed at Apple. Their work impacts products used by millions of people worldwide. Key Qualifications Fluency using statistics and visualizations to answer questions about data sets. Effective communication skills. Specifically, explaining complex issues to a variety of audiences, considering the big picture when communicating, and can summarize technical details succinctly. Strong programming skills in R, Python, and/or MATLAB. You have experience using these tools to import, clean, analyze, and visualize data to enable data-driven decision making. Experience working with multivariate and/or “large” datasets using conventional statistical techniques. Their datasets are typically not large enough to employ machine learning techniques. Strong interest in peer collaboration with a willingness to solicit input and accept feedback. An appreciation of functional design or interested in developing your design aesthetic. Experience or interest in analyzing and visualizing 3D data sets or enthusiastic about delving deeper into 3D data analysis and visualization. Their datasets include human anthropometric and biometric data, acoustic data, and inertial motion unit data (accelerometers, gyroscopes, altimeters). Familiar with SQL and database design or curious to learn more. Familiar with Github and software development workflows or eager to adopt these software collaboration practices. Ability to juggle multiple projects. Excited to learn to communicate important information in an easily understandable manner. Description As a member of this team-oriented, group, you will be an integral partner, working on the latest, most innovative Apple products together with many cross-functional teams. Your responsibilities will include some of the following activities: Gathering large quantities of unstructured data from many different sources. Conducting data exploration, QA/QC, visualization, statistical and data analyses, and modeling. Creating custom algorithms for large datasets to enable visualizations that help decision makers quickly understand the data. Defining data capture formats to enable useful and efficient analysis. Collaborating with teams to automate processes, conduct systems analysis, and build visualization workflows by building and deploying software tools. Creating systems for real-time or near real-time data analysis to improve precision machine performance in factories Sharing results and concepts across the company through presentations and other communication channels This small but growing team strongly inspires collaboration but also offers freedom and autonomy. Creative and outside-the-box thinking is required, and original ideas are supported by the team. Education & Experience Masters degree in an analytical field such as Human Computer Interaction, Climate or Environmental Science, Applied Math, Economics, Social Sciences, Engineering, Physics, Biological Sciences, Statistics, or Robotics along with 2+ years relevant work experience. Ph.D. degree preferred. The post Data Scientist and Visualization Specialist appeared first on Jobs Opendatascience .

title: Principal Economist (Data Science)
content_text: Direct recruiters from this company will be at the Accelerate AI Career Expo. Register for free: http://bit.ly/2MGFntn Submit Resume To: https://share.hsforms.com/1XnFwfJRKR6Gs71Qp_oiUsQ13zdw They are looking for Principal Economist, Data Science – Price Optimization to evolve the strategy, vision, and capabilities or their Data Science Pricing Ecosystem and how they engage the Shipper/Carrier logistics marketplace.  As North America’s largest 3PL, they price billions of dollars in annual truck freight via Full Truckload, Less than Truckload, and Parcel.  Their pricing critically depends upon their ability to accurately forecast & quantify expected market conditions/trends and risk via algorithms. They maintain a suite of statistical models that react to a range of inputs from broad econometric trends to real-time supply/demand market signals from within Navisphere, their core of customer and carrier facing technology as well as other real time data inputs. This is a senior leadership role in the data science and analytics department responsible for managing their algorithm policy roadmap as it relates to their pricing strategies and digital execution to align with long-term and short-term supply/demand conditions in the marketplace.  This role will also own the design and execution of shipper demand models and capacity procurement programs that build strategic density and carrier cycles to better serve a diverse marketplace of shipper/freight aggregations.  They deliver value and compete through their scale, scope and ability to aggregate shipper/carrier demand in markets that would otherwise be considered sparse and incur considerable inefficiencies.  Freight futures and other instruments are entering the truckload marketplace that provide them with new opportunities to hedge risk and balance their networks if comprehensively bundled into their marketplace strategy.  They expect this role to advise and help them best leverage these new programs.  Additionally, they seek creative leadership in “financial derivative” like products to lessen internal market friction within their brokerage is a high priority as they embrace the speed of digital freight matching. Their Data science teams will implement your policy and vision to improve internal/external marketplace efficiency.  The successful candidate will be adept at quantifying opportunities, building out supporting business cases including ROI, tracking business/algorithm outcomes via KPIs, assessing model telemetry to guide algorithm tuning/enhancement, and being the voice of industry knowledge regarding freight market dynamics/patterns that a successful ecosystem must accommodate.  Hands-on data exploration and skill in creatively describing market trends, tracking outcomes, and illustrating the art of possible are a must for any successful candidate.  This is a tremendous opportunity to improve the world’s supply chains through contributing towards the development of an ecosystem of tools that solve the world’s toughest supply chain problems. This position is based out of the Minneapolis, MN area. Responsibilities: Lead policy vision for optimizing dynamic pricing and long-term forecasting to achieve desired marketplace positions Adept at experimental design and ability to quantify impact across a diverse ecosystem of data ranging from model-based telemetry & raw user activity instrumentation to marketplace financials. Represent the voice of the truckload marketplace to the data science team in terms of industry trends and forecasting market conditions. Be committed to working in an iterative fashion to discover the best product to be built.  We value partnerships versus requirements and expect that this candidate will engage our technologists in a manner that unlocks their full potential to contribute to innovation and build truly great products. Quantify the value and impact of the technology solutions we build to fuel continued investment and leadership engagement.  Be a master at hands on data manipulation and establishing key performance metrics that measure business outcomes and impact.  Must be able to extract data from source systems and deliver a wide variety of stake holder insights to fuel program velocity and adoption. Act as subject-matter expert on all data science pricing systems and technologies to non-technical stakeholders. Be an agent of change and advocate for continual improvement in the way we innovate/design/develop/deploy products to market. Qualifications: Masters or PhD in Economics, Business, Statistics or Quantitative Discipline required Minimum 5 years’ experience working hands-on with data developing models for business applications that drive outcomes via predictive/prescriptive guidance Proficiency in Modeling Languages (R or Python) Deep knowledge of statistical modeling & forecasting methods Knowledge of Statistical Algorithms and AI based methodologies Deep expertise on pricing, markets and economic modeling Excellent verbal and written communication skills Desire to work with cross-functional team in a software/analytics development environment Benefits They are proud to offer a top-tier benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, prescription drug coverage, paid parental leave, paid holidays and paid time off (PTO), 401K with company match, employee stock purchase plan, as well as a broad range of career development opportunities. Using the strengths of their people, processes and technology, thye help their customers work smarter, not harder. As one of the world’s largest third-party logistics providers (3PL), they provide a broad portfolio of logistics services, fresh produce sourcing and managed services through their global network. In addition, the company, their Foundation and their employees contribute annually to a variety of organizations. Headquartered in Minnesota, C.H. Robinson (CHRW) is publicly traded on the NASDAQ. For more information, visit http://www.chrobinson.com or view their company video . How to apply Please send your resume to candace.osterberg@chrobinson.com using the job title as the subject line. title: Data Scientist
content_text: About Quora Quora’s mission is to share and grow the world’s knowledge. They’re building a universal, social system that democratizes knowledge access, incentivizes users and communities of all kinds to share what they know, and solves the scaling problems that typically harm such systems, on- and offline. As you can imagine, making such a system entails solving an enormous, diverse array of problems, from the technological to the sociological. About The Data Team Unsurprisingly, then, the Data Team is highly empowered at Quora, helping navigate complexity and influencing product and company strategy directly. Quora’s outsized commitment to data is visible in everything we do, from our rigor-driven experimentation processes to the backgrounds of our leaders (including many Product Managers and the Head of Product being former full-time data scientists). With this emphasis on data and empirics, they aim to balance rigor and pragmatism, searching for scrappy solutions in pursuit of their mission. In joining Quora’s strong data team, you’ll both benefit from and work to advance their culture of rational decision making. About This Role As a data scientist, you’ll work closely with product managers, product designers, and engineers to devise appropriate measurements and metrics, design randomized controlled experiments, build visualizations, and tackle hard, open-ended problems that uncover usage patterns and opportunities for the company. Quora has a wide range of rich data, giving you ample room for exploration and creativity. Examples of some projects their data scientists have worked on include modeling their long-term growth, improving the relevance and personalization of the homepage feed, and exploratory analysis of factors driving question-asking behavior. For more about their work, see Quora’s Data blog at https://data.quora.com/ . title: Data Scientist, Marketing Measurement Analytics
content_text: Are you a successful data scientist with a passion for modeling and optimization? Reporting into the Sr Director, Marketing Measurement Analytics, you’ll serve as the subject matter expert on the development of Marketing Mix Models and Multi-Touch Attribution Models (MMM/MTA). Collaborative Data Ingestion/Curation: Work with Engineering to ingest and curate data yielding a strong foundation for Marketing Analytics. Perform data collection, preparation, and validation necessary for model development and analysis. title: VP, Global Sales Engineering
content_text: Dataiku’s mission is big: to enable all people throughout companies around the world to use data by removing friction surrounding data access, cleaning, modeling, deployment, and more. But it’s not just about technology and processes; at Dataiku, they also believe that people (including their people!) are a critical piece of the equation. They’re looking to fill an opening for Vice President, Sales Engineering at Dataiku. The VP of Sales Engineering oversees Dataiku’s global team of Sales Engineers and Sales Engineering managers. With more than 25 team members today, the team will likely grow to 40+ in the coming 12 months. The Sales Engineering function at Dataiku is the primary technical function within the Sales organization, providing pre-sales support to the Account Executives and directly contributing to Dataiku’s revenue objectives. As the “trusted advisors” in the sales process, the Sales Engineers help to build interest in Dataiku, build the solution to the prospect’s needs, and then build the evaluation to provide the prospect with the proof that they need to make their purchasing decision. The Vice President role is a key, senior management role at Dataiku, reporting directly into the Chief Revenue Officer. The VP of Sales Engineering will own objectives related to their ability to deliver compelling, highly technical customer engagements in the field. Key responsibilities in the coming months will be the enablement of the existing team, hiring for 2020, and ensuring excellence in their execution. Given the cross-cutting nature of the function, this role will have direct interaction with top management and the executive team. RESPONSIBILITIES Monitor key metrics relevant to the efficiency and efficacy of our sales delivery Establish and oversee technical enablement for the Sales Engineering team Directly manage the Regional Sales Engineering Managers Contribute to the development of the 2020 hiring plan, and then execute on that plan, directly overseeing the hiring of 15+ sales engineers Oversee onboarding and enablement efforts Coordinate closely with the post-sales Customer team to ensure smooth handovers of new clients Coordinate closely with the Product, Engineering, and R&D teams to ensure that the needs of the field are appropriately communicated back to those who can address them in the product REQUIREMENTS 10+ years of professional experience, including significant team management experience Enterprise sales experience in the B2B software sector, ideally in the big data, analytics, ML, and/or AI spaces Strong technical knowledge related to data science, analytics, distributed computing (on-premise and cloud), ML and their applications and constraints in the enterprise Experience rapidly hiring highly technical profiles Analytic, data-driven mindset for setting up and measuring team staffing and other key delivery metrics A bridge-building communication style, with excellent written and verbal skills, to collaborate proactively with the many teams at Dataiku on which the success of the role dependsExperience working in a target driven environment, and the ability to work towards deadlines and in a fast-paced environment Strong ambition and an appreciation for “reach” objectives, where the goal is to make a maximum impact with minimum resources Ideally located in (or willing to relocate to) New York, Denver, Paris, or London. However, remote is a possibility for the right candidate BENEFITS Opportunity to have significant responsibility at Dataiku early on and help scale the company in a meaningful and measurable way Competitive compensation package, equity, health benefits, and paid vacation Trips to Paris Opportunity to work with a smart, passionate and driven team Dataiku has a strong culture based on key values: Ownership, Passion, Autonomy and Friendliness Dataiku is an end-to-end collaboration platform that is revolutionizing how data science teams from 5 to 5,000 people work together to create and share insights from big data. Their software is designed to be the one place where everyone in the data science process works together: it’s as powerful for PhD data scientists as it is for Business Analysts as it is for Dev Ops engineers as it is for IT professionals. Their customers include companies like GE, Unilever, Fox, Comcast, Capgemini, and many more. They raised their $101 million Series C in December 2018 with Iconiq Ventures, a preeminent VC fund known for their highly selective investment strategy. They’re growing really quickly (more than doubling every year), and they’re building out their global presence with amazing team members in France, the US, the UK, the Netherlands, and Singapore (with more locations on the way). They’re looking for really talented, smart, kind, and genuinely curious individuals to work alongside them. To fulfill its mission, Dataiku is growing fast (having just closed a $101 million Series C round in December 2018 and looking to double in 2019), but still maintains a startup spirit. Dataiku serves its global customer base from its headquarters in New York City as well as offices in Paris, London, Munich, Singapore, and Sydney. Each of their offices has a unique culture, but underpinning local nuances, they always value curiosity, collaboration, and can-do attitudes. These data experts pair deep data modeling expertise with business understanding and project management to make answering key business questions as streamlined as possible. What You’ll Do Own an entire key area of data within Wayfair from generation to consumption, such as a trillion row clickstream dataset or product information from hundreds of suppliers Build, schedule, and manage data movement from application origin through batch and streaming systems to make it available for key business decisions Develop a robust, sustainable plan for the data area going forward, including projecting space requirements, procuring technology, and partnering with engineering on improvements to the data Ensure data products are aligned with the rapidly evolving needs of a multi-billion dollar business Provide consulting to engineering and data engineering organizations on best practices for designing applications to enable easy analytics; be an expert on large-scale data engineering Who You Are A true expert on big data, comfortable working with datasets of varying latencies and size and disparate platforms Excited about unlocking the valuable data hidden in inaccessible raw tables and logs Attentive to detail and with a relentless focus on accuracy Excited to collaborate with partners in business reporting and engineering to determine the source of truth of key business metrics Familiarity with distributed data storage systems and the tradeoffs inherent in each one What You Have Hands on time with advanced SQL including writing complex, multi-stage transformations, user-defined functions, stored procedures, and tuning query performance. title: Data Scientist / Machine Learning Engineer (Search Science)
content_text: Imagine working in an environment where one experiment can catapult an entire industry toward a smarter future. That’s what they do — They’re a team of 5,000+ software engineers, data scientists, designers, and product managers within Walmart, the world’s largest retailer, delivering innovations that improve how their customers shop and their enterprise operates. Their Walmart eCommerce team is obsessed with finding ways to help their customers live better, raising the bar for an entire industry along the way. You’ll play a crucial role in shaping the future of shopping, working with crazy talented people in an environment that values kindness and transparency. With the energy of a startup and the scale of the Fortune One, it’s the ultimate innovator’s playground. Are you hungry to own your career and catapult ideas into action? Read on. They’re hiring Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to join their Search teams in Hoboken, New Jersey. In this role, you will dedicate yourself to the mission of helping millions of customers every day in finding the right products. They are at the forefront of attacking one of the most complex problems of e-commerce. Whenever a user types in a query or browses through product categories on the web site, phone, or the iPad, their service goes to work. They mine billions of search queries and tens of millions of products to find the most relevant products for their customers. Team members take end-end responsibility in analyzing large amounts of data, creating complex models, improving their accuracy, and deploying these models to serve customers. What you’ll be doing: As part of this team, you’ll solve some of the most fascinating and impactful problems in machine learning, information retrieval, NLP, and computer vision. The algorithms you develop will champion customers need to express their intent and their goal to understand their preferences, implicitly or explicitly across devices and modalities (voice, text, image, etc.). You will develop and deploy machine-learned models, to engage and converse with their customers, and to understand their goals and expectations to enable them to make the right purchase decision. Your work will be visible to millions of customers, and you will have a direct impact on the goals of the Fortune #1 enterprise. If you speak and think machine learning, then they want to talk to you. Join their team and be part of this exciting journey! They’d love to hear from you if: You have earned a Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field AND have at least 3 years of professional, postgrad experience. Your knowledge of Computer Science fundamentals in algorithms and data structures is strong. Your Python (or Java) coding skills around building scalable, low latency web-services are strong, and you have experience working with large data sets and distributed computing tools (Hadoop, Spark). You have been extremely hands-on in building machine learning products, and you have a robust portfolio of ML projects with a significant impact on the bottom line. You are involved in the community, writing papers/blogs, speaking at conferences, etc. This is that place where your passions meet the purpose. Walmart helps people around the world save money and live better – anytime and anywhere – in retail stores, online, and through their mobile devices. Each week, over 275 million customers and members visit their more than 11,300 stores under 58 banners in 27 countries and eCommerce websites. With fiscal year 2019 revenue of $514.4 billion, Walmart employs over 2.2 million associates worldwide. Since 1962 they’ve been dedicated to helping customers live better. While how they deliver on that promise evolves, why they do it stays the same. Today, they help accomplish this by engineering services across all Walmart properties (stores, app, online) that save them time and money — innovations like Online Grocery, InHome Delivery Grocery, in-store Pickup Towers, Free NextDay Delivery (without a membership fee), Scan & Go, and more. A lot of their work is behind the scenes, but that doesn’t make it any less impactful. A core philosophy here is operating with an everyday low cost. They use technology to operate smarter so that they can deliver everyday low prices to customers. This includes: Platform – Using best-in-class public, private, and hybrid cloud environments Supply chain – Developing scalable, nimble, and flexible technology that powers our hundreds of distribution and fulfillment centers and provide their supply chain partners with the tools they need to deliver for their customers Merchant – Online and in-store search, pricing, catalog, content, inventory, replenishment, and fulfillment technology to provide the optimal experience for our merchants Working at Walmart is outstanding. Learn more about their philosophy, benefits, and team at https://careers.walmart.com . At Walmart, they believe they are best equipped to help their associates, customers, and the communities they serve to live better when they really know them. That means understanding, respecting, and valuing diversity — unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas, and opinions — while being inclusive of all people. title: Data Analytics Lead
content_text: General Description Are you looking to join a company and business that is bucking the trend? Are you looking to help build a business intelligence and data and analytics capacity at one of the largest insurance companies in the country? If you answered yes to any of those questions, then this could be the job for you. This position will be part of the Operations Team within the Individual Retirement business unit at AXA Equitable reporting to the COO. The Individual Retirement business unit is the largest business unit at AXA Equitable and produced over $7 billion in sales for 2018. AXA sells individual retirement products to their clients through their captive agency, AXA Advisors, and through relationships with over 750 selling firms ranking as the #3 player in the industry. This data includes large structured and unstructured data sets (e.g., speech analytics, social media listening, digital footprints, customer behavior, financial information, proprietary market research, and secondary sources) with the goal of discovering meaningful implications for business decisions. Specific Job Duties (will evolve over time and change based on altering business priorities). Will be responsible for direct management of complex programs / projects. Manage the overall delivery of solutions for the business and ensure project proposals have a positive business case (ROI). Ensure projects are on time, on budget, and on scope. Develop and communicate goals, strategies, tactics, analytical plans, timelines, and key performance metrics to reach goals Explore the unknown, and brainstorm new ideas to drive increased sales opportunities and promote productivity and efficiencies. Drive vision for predictable and scalable analytics solutions that drive elevated business outcomes Participate in analysis of the information and formulation of business proposals and justifications to improve margins, profits and volumes, which align with the company directional statement and business model Build dashboards (using Tableau, Python and other BI tools) that illustrate how key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics are changing over time. Provide “color” and insights from the findings and make recommendations to the business Develop policies, and procedures for the collection and analysis of data Create or discover new data procurement and processing programs Cooperate with IT and the enterprise-wide data and analytics office to deploy software and hardware upgrades that make it possible for us to leverage big data use cases Design and implement complex business visualizations, dashboards, and reports to deliver insights. Analysis of complicated data sets and presenting meaningful outcomes to a variety of stakeholders Act as a translator between business and technical teams, by consulting on the data available or feasibility of acquiring data, keeping cost versus benefit in mind Develop proof of concept solutions to test and ascertain requirements for BI needs. Develop business relationships with cross-functional teams and assist with BI project scoping and requirements gathering, understanding complex business questions and needs. Make valuable contributions by providing adhoc statistical analysis Develop executive dashboard and implement new data and analytics processes & strategy, end-user self-services reporting Use data visualization, reports and data-driven presentations to present digestible conclusions and recommendations to top decision makers, so that business strategies can be designed around them Frame and investigate theories and assumptions with high-impact potential and utilize descriptive, predictive and prescriptive analytics techniques to test your theories Bring analytical expertise into cross-functional projects and work collaboratively with team leaders and subject matter experts across multiple departments, to enable data-driven decision making Qualifications Work Experience / Skill Requirements A bachelor’s (or advanced) degree in Economics, Statistics, Math, Computer Science, Engineering, Physical Sciences, or another quantitative discipline 5-8 years of work experience in agile project management, people management and data and analytic solutions development. Has managed other members of the business team, analytics team, or other project managers with a track record for successfully delivering solutions with clear ROI. Has demonstrated a deep sense of curiosity, self-directedness and strong problem-solving skills at previous jobs. Has a broad understanding of project planning and project management execution methodologies. Has experience managing large, complex programs and projects. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Ability to clearly communicate research findings to both technical and non-technical decision makers Experience in the following technical areas are required: Agile project management best practices and processes; Hadoop (Cloudera or Apache), relational databases, and SQL, ETL development, spark, data validation and testing (Data Warehousing, ETL/ELT to the Data Lake, using the Data Lake for data analysis (Hadoop tools – Hive, Impala, Pig, Sqoop, Hue, Kafka, etc., Open Source tools: Python, R, java). Knowledge of the data visualization tool, Tableau. title: Business Data Analyst
content_text: Job Description Job Posting Bose is about better sound, but better sound is just the beginning. They’re about inventing new technologies that truly benefit people, and creating a culture where innovation and teamwork are highly valued. Working at Bose, you’re encouraged to question conventional thinking in the relentless quest to create products and experiences that change people’s lives. Their culture is as distinctive as their products. Join a company that operates globally, with a culture that embraces new ideas. They have exciting Business Data Analyst employment opportunities in their Corporate Information Systems team. The team is working to build a world class data driven organization that includes Data Governance enabling advanced analytics and Data Science across Bose. The goal is to have proactive data quality, enable certified data, provide for a searchable data catalog that includes lineage from visualizations to source systems decreasing analytics time to value. The Business Data Analyst will be supporting and partnering with Consumers Electronics stakeholders. If you have a passion for creating a data driven culture by delivering value, please consider a career at Bose! Responsibilities Include The Business Data Analyst role at Bose is a blend skill set of data management tools (Data Quality, Governance, ERP, CRM and Data Analytics). The Business Data Analyst can speak data, process, business and technical language to add value and benefits solving data problem. He/She will facilitate capturing and documenting business, data, governance and technology assets. Role The Business Data Analyst role accelerates advanced analytics and Data Science time to value by executing a framework to answer the following questions What data is available (Data Catalog)? Is the data relevant and meaningful (Data classification)? What does the data mean (Technical/Business metadata, Business Glossary, and Reference Data)? Where did the data come from (Data Lineage)? What is the quality of the data (Data Quality)? Is the data verified (Certified Data)? How can I get access to the data (Processes)? Am I in compliance by using this data (Policy)? Implement a centralized data governance framework driving Bose to data driven decisions. Build enterprise systems centralized data catalogs enabling collaboration across functions and simplifying data discovery. Provide support to source systems and enterprise analytical platforms classifying data, adding data usage, and providing use case context around the data. Define and capture business and technical metadata to provide context, meaning and searchability around data and the data catalog. Define critical data elements business terms to drive common semantics across Bose. Build reference data and relate it to the critical data elements. Identify, define, measure data quality and develop critical data elements (CDEs) logical and physical lineage including data flow diagrams providing insight into focus areas applying a data governance framework. Organize Data Governance councils including functional stakeholders to align with the centralized Data Governance framework. Deliver education, training, and consulting across Bose to be an ambassador for driving data driven culture across Bose. Discover key stakeholders of data including owners, subject matter experts and existing Business Data Analysts. Work with cross-functional Business Data Analysts to understand, document and improve processes to access data (from request to provisioning). Streamline across Bose to reduce complexity executing workshops and aligning process stakeholders/owners. Provides support of Data Science and Advanced Analytics project/programs reducing administrative data governance tasks and action items. Partner with Legal, Information Security and HR to ensure compliance and security of data including how to manage data (masking, encrypting, pseudonymizing, synonymizing). Develop and align centralized policies and standards providing a baseline for functional policies. Develop and execute quarterly plans while aligning to Bose strategic vision. Track and measure wins including return on investment measuring quarterly governance results and value delivered. Skills, Knowledge and Experiences Candidate should have a minimum of 5 years of Master Data Management and solid experience understanding a Data Governance framework. Previous experience with Bose CE product/engineering/apps Solid knowledge of data relationship for structure and unstructured data. Previous experience in research working environment by governing data from internal and external partners. Work in very dynamic environment where changes are introduced rapidly in the business process, data flow and technologies. Experience in consumer industry focus on product data, sales and marketing The ideal candidate will understand how people, process and technology can come together to enable advanced analytics and data management. Experience in data quality, data governance and supporting tools (Collibra preferably) Proven experience of cross functional leadership in complex organizations with strong emphasis on influencing and collaboration. Strong analytical orientation. Teach, mentor, and provide value on a consistent basis to stakeholders. Ability to translate strategy into an operational plan and can execute delivering consistent value to Bose. Other Passion for Data and Governance. Bachelor’s degree. Knowledge of MS Office. Experience using data quality and data governance tools is a plus. Relocation is not available for this position Bose is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. They work on products that make every part of transporting via truck seamless from end-to-end, such as personalized recommendation and search, acquisition funnel, growth and dynamic pricing, shipper pricing and matching, and much more. title: Machine Learning Engineer
content_text: Aquabyte Machine Learning Engineer Aquabyte is a software company that is working to build the global food systems of tomorrow, by applying computer vision, deep learning and machine-learning technology to aquaculture. Their mission Aquabyte is on a mission to revolutionize the sustainability and efficiency of aquaculture. It is an audacious, and incredibly rewarding mission. By making fish farming cheaper and more viable than livestock production, they aim to mitigate one of the biggest causes of climate change and help prepare their planet for impending population growth. Aquaculture is the single fastest growing food-production sector in the world, and now is the time to define how technology is used to harvest the sea for generations to come. They are a diverse, mission-driven team that is eager to work alongside kindred spirits. If this vision makes you smile, gives you goosebumps, or otherwise inspires you please get in touch. Their product They are currently focused on helping Norwegian salmon farmers better understand their fish populations and make environmentally-sound decisions. Through custom underwater cameras, computer vision, and machine learning they are able to quantify fish weights, detect sea lice infestations, and generate optimal feeding plans in real time. Their product operates at three levels: on-site hardware for image capture, cloud pipelines for data processing, and a user-facing web application. As a result, there are hundreds of moving pieces and no shortage of fascinating challenges across all levels of the stack. Above all, Aquabyte is a customer-driven company. Their product development is dictated by the needs of fish farmers and they prioritize customer delight in everything they do. They are committed to build a global, collaborative team that creates value far beyond Silicon Valley. THE ROLE: Their product entirely relies on machine learning and computer vision. They employ object detection, segmentation, classification algorithms among many others. This position is at the intersection of their research and engineering teams, where you will help maximizing the output of the research team by speeding up training times and data pipelines. title: Senior Data Scientist
content_text: They’re looking for a senior data scientist who is passionate about making a positive difference in the world. Published 3rd September 2019 Full-time, in-house London 1 The Problem Type 2 diabetes and obesity are huge problems, both for the millions of people that suffer from lifestyle diseases, as well as healthcare systems like the NHS. In the UK they spend almost 10% of the NHS budget on treating type 2 diabetes alone (£9 billion/year). What’s shocking is almost all of this is avoidable, 80-90% in fact. How? Through sustained lifestyle and weight loss. It sounds so simple, but in reality is much harder to achieve at scale. 2 OurPath OurPath provide a digital lifestyle improvement programme that is proven to help people improve their lifestyle and lose weight, which ultimately reduces their risk for conditions such as type 2 diabetes. The programme incorporates evidence-based education, health coaches, peer group support, and digital tracking tools. Everything is delivered digitally through phone and web apps. The quickest way to understand what they do is watch this very short 1 min animation: https://vimeo.com/199648301 They were the first digital behavioural change programme to be commissioned by the NHS – they’re now expanding rapidly having won a few big national contracts (both in diabetes prevention and management). Alongside their NHS work, they also offer the programme directly to consumers – you can buy the programme on their website if you’re looking to make a healthy lifestyle change and lose weight. Their direct-to-consumer channel is essentially a competitor to the likes of Weight Watchers and Slimming World. About them: They are now a team of 50 – consisting of ex-strategy consultants, dietitians, designers, and developers. They believe OurPath is a fun place to work with an informal, non-bureaucratic, and agile working environment. Finally, they will provide endless amounts of poor jokes and sub-standard humour. Just so you know. Some of their national press: TechCrunch – https://techcrunch.com/2018/08/10/ourpath-raises-3m-in-round-led-by-connect-ventures-to-reverse-type-2-diabetes/?guccounter=1 Wired – https://www.wired.co.uk/article/ourpath-diabetes-app-roche-nhs-partnership 3 The role They are looking for a senior data scientist, not only to help them build and grow their product but also their data team. What you’ll do: Help junior analysts deliver insightful analysis to discover areas of opportunity that shape the product roadmap. Lead the development of new data-driven product features. Work with product to design and analyse product tests. Work with engineering to ensure that good ETL processes are in place to deliver clean and accurate data to team members. Collaborate with members of all teams to ensure that data is easily accessible to answer business decisions and drive the decision-making process. 4 Person Specification Required: Experience querying databases and using statistical computer languages Coding knowledge and experience with several languages (Python/R required) Experience in Machine Learning applications Nice to have: Knowledge of a variety of machine learning techniques (clustering, decision tree learning, artificial neural networks, etc.) and their real-world advantages/drawbacks Strong knowledge of advanced statistical techniques and concepts (regression, properties of distributions, statistical tests and proper usage, etc.) and experience with applications Experience managing a team of data analysts/scientists. 5 What can they offer you? You’ll be able to provide direct input into how they should improve their product and the development of OurPath. You’ll get to work with amazing, friendly, smart colleagues all incredibly passionate about solving the type 2 diabetes epidemic. You’ll have autonomy and responsibility for your work direction; they also offer a flexible working environment where you can work from home when you need to. They have regular company-sponsored socials (pub drinks, team dinners, board games and movie nights) that’ll allow you to catch up and make friends outside of your team. They all have a thirst for knowledge and have regular Lunch&Learn sessions to help them expand their knowledge base; the product team also get together and run quarterly Hackathons. 6 To Apply This position is available to start immediately, so please send your CV and cover letter via this application page: https://workable.com/j/B45EE2ECED They’ll be interviewing on a rolling basis, so the quicker you can apply the better. If Ben doesn’t respond within 7 days then he’s not intentionally being rude but please assume it’s probably a no for now. The post Senior Data Scientist appeared first on Jobs Opendatascience .

content_text: Nielsen is the largest measurement company in the world with unique measurement technologies, assets, and data that make it one of the most interesting and challenging places for a data scientist to work.  They focus on what consumers watch, listen to, and buy in over 95 countries. Data Science is core to what Nielsen does, and their research projects have high visibility in directly affecting the results of their business and their clients.   This Senior Data Scientist role in the Digital Product team provides an opportunity to contribute to methodological innovation in the exciting and fast-changing world of digital media measurement.This is an ideal position to grow as a researcher, contribute to innovative products, and develop subject-matter expertise in digital methodology and cross-platform audience measurement. As part of this exciting team, this position will focus on developing new methodologies to measure audiences across platforms (including on “connected” or “over the top” devices, smart tv’s, or set top boxes) and on evaluating and integrating new data assets and partners into Nielsen’s existing methodologies in order to enhance or expand the data delivered to clients. In addition, the team has responsibility for end-to-end ownership of the continued success of Nielsen’s local television measurement products. (Master’s degree preferred) 2 to 3 years of experience with one or more of the following: python programming, data manipulation, data integration, weighting, sampling, survey or market research, trend or pattern recognition, statistics, data aggregation techniques, automation, or quality assurance. Must be proficient with Python, Spark, or Scala to develop sharable software with the appropriate technical documentation. Must be proficient in SQL and large-scale databases. Must have ability to manipulate, analyze, interpret large data sources, and tell a story from data through analyses Must have strong verbal and written communication skills. Must have ability to work alone and with a team Must have critical thinking skills necessary to evaluate results in order to make decisions Must demonstrate intellectual curiosity and persistence to find answers Demonstrate interest in Nielsen methodologies, data collection, platforms, research processes and operations. Skills Desired: Experience with data visualization tools (e.g. Tableau, Spotfire) Experience with machine learning techniques Experience working with cloud based or big data technologies (e.g. Databricks) Proficiency in Unix Key Responsibilities Learn and become an expert in how big data flows through Nielsen systems in order to create reliable data pipelines that will feed into methodology development processes. Drive technical solutions to complex business problems.  From lightweight automation to designing and building robust/scalable solutions.  Strong focus on optimization. title: Machine Learning Engineer – Health ML
content_text: Are you an engineer who’s interested in tackling very challenging adversarial problems and passionate about defending online users against abuse, spam, and manipulation? Do you love working on challenging problems that require a multi-disciplinary approach, creative solutions, and rapid product iterations? Will you be proud to work on a real-time, scalable system that serves millions of users daily? If so, you should join us. Who They Are The Health ML engineering team is responsible for building scalable detection systems that keep spam, manipulation, and abuse at bay. They use ML and relevance techniques to make Twitter safer and to limit the spread of misinformation on the platform. Their team works across the product to detect abusive and spammy users and content, increase action on bad actors, drive changes in user behavior, and detect and remediate accounts that are violating the terms of service on Twitter. They develop, maintain, and contribute to several machine learning models and systems, including: Models that detect unwanted interactions Models to prioritize human review of accounts violating Twitter’s policies to more quickly take action and limit their damage Detection of bots that misuse the platform or spread misinformation Detection of repeat abusive offenders who create new accounts after being suspended Real-time rule engines and clustering systems to identify and action on clusters of bad actors at scale What You’ll Do Although you will work on cutting-edge problems, this position is not a pure research position. You’ll apply data science, machine learning, and/or graph analysis techniques to a variety of modeling and relevance problems involving users, their social graph, their tweets, and their behavior. You’re experienced at solving large scale relevance problems and comfortable doing incremental quality work while building brand new systems to enable future improvements. You are knowledgeable in one or more of the following: machine learning (including deep learning), information retrieval, recommendation systems, social network analysis. You strive to find the right balance between moving fast to deliver quality improvements to users and accumulating technical debt that drags down productivity. title: Data Engineer, B2B Data Platform R&D
content_text: Data Engineer, B2B Data Platform R&D The B2B Data Platform Engineering and Analytics team builds tools to automate both analytical and operational workflows. They are part of the B2B Insights & Analytics (I&A) organization, which manages the sustainable growth of the B2B sales with a focus on creating lasting relationships between customers and their sales teams. You will maintain operational processes in the B2B “Operations Hub”, a web app that provides business users with an interface to abstract complex optimization algorithms. (You will learn the basics of web development and container orchestration in Kubernetes!) You will work directly with analytics, operations, and sales teams to identify problems and scope solutions (we are their own product managers). You will build internal python libraries to streamline analytics workflows, with an emphasis on intuitive interface design. You will become a subject matter expert in the B2B data model. You should evangelize code quality best practices (testing, style, documentation) and help analysts improve the quality of their code What You’ll Need Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field from top-tier institution Server-side programming experience (we write a lot of Python) Familiarity with version control techniques and best practices Experience writing complex SQL (+1 if you have performance tuning experience) Process-oriented mindset with strong organizational and communication skills Comfort with prototyping and scoping MVPs for ambiguously defined opportunities Experience writing unit and integration tests [Nice to have] Experience developing or deploying containerized apps (Docker, K8s) [Nice to have] About Them Wayfair is one of the world’s largest online destinations for the home. Through their commitment to industry-leading technology and creative problem-solving, they are confident that Wayfair will be home to the most rewarding work of your career. If you’re looking for rapid growth, constant learning, and dynamic challenges, then you’ll find that amazing career opportunities are knocking. No matter who you are, Wayfair is a place you can call home. They’re a community of innovators, risk-takers, and trailblazers who celebrate their differences, and know that their unique perspectives make them stronger, smarter, and well-positioned for success. They value and rely on the collective voices of their employees, customers, community, and suppliers to help guide them as they build a better Wayfair – and world – for all. Every voice, every perspective matters. That’s why they’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. title: Financial Data Analyst
content_text: Vroom.com is a venture-backed, fast-growing start-up focused on revolutionizing the car buying experience. Their approach is unique in that we recondition pre-owned vehicles to a high standard, sell online, and deliver anywhere across the US. They have experienced tremendous growth in their first 5 years of operation and have become a disruptive force in the automotive industry. Vroom is an exciting, accelerating workplace, and there’s no better time to join the team than right now. They’re looking for a Supply Strategy Senior Analyst/Manager with strong analytical ability and business acumen to dissect, aggregate and interpret market and operational data at the most granular level. The Supply Strategy Senior Analyst/Manager is expected to make significant contributions to the success of Vroom by generating detailed analyses around core supply metrics to allow their vehicle buying team to make informed, data-driven decisions. Additionally, the Supply Strategy Senior Analyst/Manager will play a major role in driving inventory management and overall inventory decision making. To succeed, you will need to develop creative solutions to abstract strategic problems, deliver your work in a clear and compelling format, and balance big picture thinking with exceptional attention to detail. This position requires a driven self-starter who takes tasks from start to finish, enjoys working in a fast-paced, challenging environment, and has a thirst for knowledge to not just understand the “what” but the “why”. Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States Responsibilities: • Designing, enhancing, and owning daily and weekly sourcing and inventory reports • Partnering with our buying team to make data driven decision to improve sales velocity and profitability • Creating and managing operational models and forecasts, developing compelling outputs that track and predict key supply metrics • Becoming a subject matter expert on our internal and external data • Analyzing weekly financial and operational trends to interpret the impact of changes in the business • Working with key stakeholders to create data driven solutions to business problems • Constantly maintaining an understanding of both the fine details, and abstract implications, of the above types of work Qualifications: • 3 to 5 years’ experience in data, data analytics, statistics, and/or inventory management • Substantial experience with data modeling and high proficiency in Excel • Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in a quantitative field (mathematics, statistics, science) • Familiarity with Looker or Tableau a plus • Passion for cars preferred but not required • A fast learner who’s driven and motivated to produce best-in-class results • Desire to propel the business forward and help in all ways possible • Ability to forge strong relationships with business partners at all levels of the organization • Ability to multi-task & prioritize • Rigorous attention to detail • Excellent oral and written communication skills • A strong understanding of basic financial principles • A combination of EQ and IQ – always balancing creativity, situational awareness and objective information • An ability to take on, and succeed with, a diverse array of projects that require varying skills and approaches • A strong desire to work in a startup environment generally, and at Vroom specifically • An appetite to take on increased responsibility and grow your career quickly • An ability to create order out of chaos, distill learnings, and communicate findings elegantly to team members. Benefits This full-time role offers competitive compensation; health, dental & vision insurance through United Healthcare; a 401k plan; fully company-paid short term disability, long term disability, and life insurance; access to a healthcare concierge service with virtual visits; and 15 annualized days of paid vacation. But their biggest benefit is being part of a low-ego, high performing team that’s transforming the used car market into a modern, online and data-driven industry. They are looking for people who want to be a part of a contemporary startup culture. What gets them out of bed is working with talented people on a mission that matters. title: Clinical Data Scientist
content_text: About Syapse Maybe you’ve supported a friend or family member who’s dealing with cancer. Maybe you’ve battled it yourself. At Syapse, their mission is to enable healthcare providers to deliver the best care to every cancer patient through precision medicine and it’s their personal connections to this mission that unites them. Together, they’re building a revolutionary platform that integrates complex oncology data and shares insights across the cancer care ecosystem including cancer care centers and life science companies developing the next generation of cancer diagnostics and medicines. Join them in their mission to make precision medicine available to every cancer patient who needs it and help them make a positive impact in the lives of people battling cancer, their families and the organizations committed to their care. About the role: Syapse is looking for a Clinical Data Scientist to build on their efforts to enable clinical decision making using a genuinely unique set of real world data and Syapse software. They’ve created a large real-world data set which aggregates and standardizes patient clinical history and molecular profiling results with treatments, and outcomes from multiple disparate sources. This unparalleled comprehensive set of real world data can be used to extract insights such as new treatment paradigms and more efficient research pathways. Not only are the data insights you will be able to generate uniquely possible at Syapse, but these insights will be applied directly to improving patient outcomes at the point of care. This position will report to the Senior Director of Informatics within the Clinical Data Science team and collaborate daily with a cross-functional team of product managers, software engineers, informaticists, clinicians, data scientists, and others in a fast-paced and mission driven environment. About You: You will be their bridge between cancer data needs & technology solutions to put real world data into context and generate meaningful insights. You enjoy translating complicated concepts into digestible results and executing against multiple simultaneous projects. Your strong working knowledge of clinical / healthcare data and analytics is augmented with a deep understanding of the application of precision medicine within oncology. Key Responsibilities: Expertise: Be a domain expert in the field of oncology data, the Syapse platform, and the optimal methods to solve clinical problems using their data and platform. Deliver: Ability to multi-task and execute on concurrent projects within Syapse and with their clients and partners. Collaborate: Work closely with internal teams to improve their core products, analytic capabilities, and data sets as well as working directly with clients and partners on answering their questions and solving their problems. Educate: Share clinical data insights internally to enhance our shared understanding, share ideas where they can innovate, and publish novel insights. Requirements : Masters, PhD, or MD in oncology, clinical, biomedical or health informatics or a related field, from a leading institution or equivalent work experience. 2+ years of experience working with applied data in oncology / precision medicine, including performing data analytics projects and participating in a client-facing role. Demonstrated proficiency in clinical oncology data (medical terminology such as diagnoses, treatments and biomarkers, provider workflow, and clinical trials). Deep professional experience leveraging data from various clinical systems, like EHR, pharmacy, Lab information systems, and claims. Experience working with standard controlled vocabularies like; SNOMED-CT, LOINC, RxNorm, NDC, ICD-9, ICD-10, CPT, HCPCS, OncoTree. Ability to write scripts (e.g. python, perl) to perform data manipulation and analysis. Experience with a query language such as SPARQL or SQL. Experience with a statistical package such as R. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with emphasis on relaying complex information and concepts in more relatable terms. Preferred Skills or Experience: Experience with analyzing clinical and genomic data for external clients. Experience with developing predictive models. Experience with advanced analytic techniques, including machine learning. Experience with developing and refining data models. Publications around clinical data analysis. Entrepreneurial experience. Benefits and perks Amazing Coworkers Competitive pay and ownership in the company 100% company paid medical, dental and vision for employees 401(K) matching Flexible time off Transit assistance & Pre-tax commuter benefits. title: Principal Data Scientist
content_text: Job # 521724 What You’ll Be Doing… As a Principal Data Scientist, you’ll be ensuring that analytics drive continuous business improvements, bringing more profitable growth and an even better customer experience. You’ll define the analytics strategy and champion that strategy across the business, in order to create buy-in for data-driven decision making. Your end goal is to recommend improvements that will go straight to the bottom line, by helping them serve their customers. Partner with others to understand business challenges. Design creative approaches to uncover the biggest opportunities for cost and time savings. Define and drive the analytics strategy and modeling approaches. Build business cases and translating findings into practical business implications. Drive the adoption of analytics in decision making. You’ll Need To Have What they’re looking for… Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience. Six or more years of relevant work experience. Experience with SQL and either Python, R or SAS Project management experience. Experience working across channels and work groups. Experience working with CRM systems, operations, and finance to deliver against marketing objectives. Experience inMicrosoft Office suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint. Even Better If You Have Master’s degree or MBA. Experience building relationships and working as a team player. Five or more years of experience in the wireless industry. Delivering results in a marketing capacity with experience in loyalty and retention, base campaigns and CRM strategy development/execution. Excellent oral and written communication skills; with demonstrated experience building and delivering executive level presentations Experience working with Marketing and Go-To-Market teams on delivering high quality training materials. Passion for their customers – fully wanting to understand their needs and wants and how they can better serve them. Capability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing environment that requires a high degree of multi-tasking with minimal supervision. Willingness to travel. When you join Verizon… You’ll be doing work that matters alongside other talented people, transforming the way people, businesses and things connect with each other. Beyond powering America’s fastest and most reliable network, they’re leading the way in broadband, cloud and security solutions, Internet of Things and innovating in areas such as, video entertainment. Of course, they will offer you great pay and benefits, but they’re about more than that. Verizon is a place where you can craft your own path to greatness. Whether you think in code, words, pictures or numbers, find your future at Verizon. Equal Employment Opportunity They’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer- and celebrate their employees’ differences,including race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, and Veteran status. title: Senior Data Scientist, Measurement
content_text: Data Science At The Trade Desk At The Trade Desk, the Data Science team is responsible for transforming their hundreds of terabytes of Real-Time Bidding (RTB) advertising auction data into actionable intelligence, using advanced modelling and optimization algorithms. Their mission is to develop new and powerful means of growing the value of their client’s campaigns across millions of web-based publishers. Their team believes in innovation that contributes to their product. In this role, you will be a key member in the development of entirely new data products and the improvement of existing data, all while using world-class modelling & machine learning. You will interact primarily with their Product Management, Trading, Data Partnerships, and Data Engineering teams to oversee the implementation of your data products. Your ideas and research will contribute directly to their client facing products. What You Will Be Doing You’ll be a member of their data science team with a focus on ads measurement. In this role, you will be a subject matter expert on every part of their ads measurement offering – conversion lift and experiments, synthetic controls, reach and frequency, brand lift, etc. In addition, you will be an expert in the processes and data that enable these solutions – understanding the role of identity and advocating for changes if needed, building ways to account for missing transaction data, correcting non-response bias, panel bias, and so on. Your day-to-day will be spent interfacing between their Product Management, Data Partnerships, and Data Engineering teams to help lead the development and improvement of their measurement solutions. In this role you may also serve as a technical lead, guiding projects and mentoring junior members of the team In addition to leading their measurement efforts, you will also be a contributing member to the broader data science team, which includes the following responsibilities Be an advocate for good science Be an intellectually generous and collaborative team member Maintain a focus on shipping product, understanding that often done is better than perfect Provide input into the collection of new data sources and the refinement of existing ones to improve analysis and model development Become an expert on TTD’s client-facing platform What You Bring To The Table NON-TECHNICAL QUALIFICATIONS: You are enthusiastic to learn and teach statistical methods, machine learning techniques and advancements in the ad tech industry You are comfortable working on an agile, distributed team spanning multiple time zones and continents You have an abundance of intellectual curiosity You are able to explain insights and provide actionable recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences Experience in advertising or publishing related industry a plus Technical Qualifications A background in experimental design and causal inference A MS or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, or related field 5+ years of professional or academic experience in a data driven role working with massive data sets Experience with big data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, Spark, AWS and the ability to write efficient SQL Experience in multiple programming languages (Python, R, Java, Scala, etc.) The Trade Desk does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm recruiters. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of The Trade Desk. The Trade Desk is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs.
